summary: WF-03 Step 1 root-cause diagnosis (diagnosis-as-design) for GH-792/ISS-0707 (prm-09 pack-update 42703). CONFIRMED the ISS-0707 diagnosis for fresh-migration DBs, with two corrections. Root cause: the PRM-09 intended table is public.solution_pack_installs (migration 1157, '-- scope: public.' with public.-qualified DDL after the GH-785 fix 51170eed); a DIFFERENT feature's table tenant_default.solution_pack_installs (migration 1158, '-- scope: tenant_only', SOL-02, columns id/pack_id/pack_version/schema_version/installed_by/installed_at — NO tenant_id/installed_version) shadows it for unqualified references under the per-tenant search_path 'tenant_default,public' that the pool applies for the zero-UUID tenant context (SCHEMA mode, pool.zig applyRequestStorageRouting). On a fresh migration replay the unqualified INSERT/SELECT in the test file -> 42703 on all 4 TC-PRM-09 tests (matches ISS-0707's 4/4 FAIL). VERIFIED EMPIRICALLY: on this workspace's current warm bpm_test (:5453) tenant_default.solution_pack_installs currently has the 1157 column layout (a legacy artifact from the ORIGINAL 1157 at commit 47d4c7c9, whose unrecognized '-- Scope:' capital-S header defaulted to all-schema scope and whose DDL was unqualified), so the compiled prm-09 test binary currently PASSES 4/4 (masked) — the 42703 WILL reproduce on any clean replay (CI), so the fix must not rely on the warm-DB state. SCOPE CORRECTION (MAJOR): the SUT src/definition/pack_update.zig ALSO issues unqualified queries (line 117 'FROM solution_pack_installs' with WHERE tenant_id, line 179 'FROM solution_pack_artefact_bases'), so on a fresh DB the SUT itself raises 42703 and a test-code-only fix is INSUFFICIENT — Step 3 must ALSO qualify the two public-schema tables in pack_update.zig. process_definitions must remain unqualified (tenant-side table, lines 145/160 in the test and 235 in pack_update.zig). Fix spec, verification target (test-integration-prm09), and the corrected DB URL (:5453) documented in result.fix_spec. No fix implemented (Step 1 only).

issues_found.description: Documented 'test-code only, no production code' scope is INSUFFICIENT. src/definition/pack_update.zig (SUT computePackUpdatePlan) queries solution_pack_installs unqualified (line 117) and solution_pack_artefact_bases unqualified (line 179). On a fresh-migration DB the SUT itself raises 42703 (tenant_id/installed_version columns missing in the 1158-layout tenant_default shadow), so a test-file-only fix would still leave all 4 TC-PRM-09 tests failing. Fix spec expanded to include pack_update.zig (exactly one production file).
ISS-0707 / issue-cited verification target 'test-integration-prm-09' does not exist; the actual build.zig:3164 step is 'test-integration-prm09' (test file header comment agrees).

ISS-0707 describes migration 1157 as 'scope: tenant_only per the GH-785 fix'. Actual 1157 header is '-- scope: public.' with public.-qualified DDL (GH-785 commit 51170eed). The tenant_default shadowing table is migration 1158 (SOL-02, '-- scope: tenant_only').

ISS-0707 reproduction cites BPM_TEST_DB_URL port 5434; this workspace's test DB is :5453 (.env BPM_TEST_DB_PORT). Also psql on PATH is a Copilot debugCommand .cmd shim that mangles arguments (always returns 1) — DB probes must use python+psycopg2 or the real psql.exe.
